Official and attributed written evidence only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Run 180 is REQUEST_NOT_COMPLETED: its immutable request at commit 8bb5820311aa339814b26d674d0b510f93fad777 failed before Spotify lookup because Lead 2 placement 2 referenced a non-ledger URI. No Run 180 identity received a resolution, verdict or utility addition; this recovery uses a new runId and current sourceCommit.
Run 178's Bristol bass/garage, Yunx, Procombo and Colomboi field was not recycled; failed Runs 175 and 177 and repair Runs 176 and 179 supplied no reusable musical verdicts.
Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, prior discovery leads and exact tracks already in the global utility ledger were excluded.
